title: Dumagat, Remontado Language (AGV)... | Ethnologue Free
text: Remontado Dumagat is an endangered indigenous language of the Philippines. It belongs to the Austronesian language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by older adults only.

text: The Remontado are fond of music. They sing during feasts, gatherings. and ceremonies.The Remontado Dumagat were traditionally found in the mountains around the boundary between Sampaloc district in Tanay, Rizal, and General Nakar, Quezon (Lobel 2013:72-73).

title: Dumagat, Remontado - Department of Linguistics - UP Diliman
text: Dumagat, Remontado is classified as moribund (EGIDS 8a) and was once thought to be no longer in use back in 2006 (Eberhard et al., 2022). A more recent study approximated that there are about 325 speakers left, all aged 50 years and above (Lobel & Surbano, 2019).
